briefBinding.catalogueRequirement: V10-122 canonical Blentera self-tool naming/metadata contract + safe paperclip-self:* compatibility/deprecation.
briefBinding.transitionClause: §56.6 MIG-06: deprecation, sunset, removal and retirement are separate; no universal fixed window; support replacement/consumer migration and observe actual cadence.
briefBinding.rawApiFallbackClause: §21B.25 applies to temporary raw REST/API/CLI fallbacks. These are canonical typed tool-name compatibility aliases and are not reclassified as raw API fallbacks.

metadata.notes: Same immutable operating-procedure bytes as V2, bound to the source-corrected existing-API operation manifest. API-only metadata does not register tools or qualify runtime profiles. Fresh admissions may bind V3; existing Run pins remain unchanged.

currentPlatformSkillRelease.interpretation: Exact read-only latest immutable release-registry record; not modified by this inventory.

currentTransition.reason: Legacy aliases remain active. Actual external consumers and usage cadence are not measured; no expiry is invented.
currentTransition.runtimeQualification: source compatibility only; installed runtime/provider, external consumer and operator qualification remain open.
currentTransition.replacement: The canonical `blentera.*` typed operation in each row; equivalent installed-runtime availability is not yet demonstrated for every profile.
cutoverRequirements: Inventory actual in-repository and external consumers and measure use for their observed operating cadence; unknown is not zero.
Prove the canonical replacement is usable with equivalent authority, idempotency, current policy and recovery on every runtime/profile that still claims support.
Name the operation owner and rollout/operator owner; communicate a migration guide and approved sunset version only after evidence supports it.
Run a removal regression proving a retired alias is undiscoverable, rejected as tool_not_found, and cannot dispatch or produce an effect.
Preserve a tested rollback to the prior gateway/operation mapping before crossing the approved retirement point.
currentTransition.fixedWindow: none; the binding clause rejects a universal interval.

rollback.procedure: Revert the gateway/operation mapping and this compatibility inventory together to the prior reviewed source bundle; restore its recorded operation/tool contract hashes. Keep prior immutable Platform Skill release bytes intact and admit its matching pins for new runs only.
rollback.doesNotClaim: A rollback cannot undo external effects already performed under an alias.

sourceScan.purpose: Literal alias path scan plus a separately enumerated runtime-instruction Markdown corpus; neither is usage telemetry or external consumer discovery.
runtimeInstructionSelection: all SKILL.md under skills/ and skills-releases/
all Markdown under skills/blentera-platform/ and skills-releases/blentera-platform/
all SKILL.md under server/src/ and packages/
